explication: This repository indexes GitHub repositories that contain Claude Code plugins, publishes validated catalog snapshots, and serves them through a searchable web catalog. The main flow is crawler discovery, GitHub enrichment, durable run tracking, snapshot validation/publication, then UI browsing and repository detail/Markdown delivery. The README excerpt identifies the product and catalog scale; source evidence is partial, so uncertain implementation links—especially crawler-to-UI data handoff and unsampled UI routes—are omitted.
